title: Legal Writing and Drafting Skills
overview: This course emphasizes precise legal writing tailored for a global audience. Effectively communicating with English-speaking lawyers goes beyond mere words; it involves grasping the distinct way these individuals think and engage with the legal, political, and business realms. Featuring numerous exercises and examples, this practical course aims to foster interactivity and stimulate engagement. Participants will engage in activities that involve creating typical legal documents commonly used in the workplace
audience: This course is designed for lawyers, legal secretaries, commercial managers, contract managers, and individuals tasked with drafting, amending, or updating contracts, legal letters, and legal opinions. It is also suitable for non-native English speakers seeking a better understanding of English legal terms
methodology: The course includes group discussions, individual tasks, and team activities, incorporating continuous writing practice throughout the exercises
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Apply plain English writing style to all legal documents
Identify the necessity for legal clarity in various types of legal documents: legal letters, emails, memoranda, and opinions
Demonstrate the appropriate register for legal writing
Rectify common mistakes in legal writing
Address pitfalls and issues related to the use of legal jargon
